desc:
Come on, grab your friends! It’s time to head to super-duper distant lands and get totally heroic. Join Finn the Human, Jake the Dog, and a whole bunch of mathematical buds for nonstop, action-packed shenanigans across the Land of Ooo!

Play as your favourite characters and dive in:
💫Go on totally epic adventures
👊 Team up with your pals (homies help homies, always)
💪Smack down gnarly mobs and mega bosses
🏹Take on quests that are heroic, goofy, or both
⚔️ Battle your way through the Dungeon Train
✨Power up and level your weapons
🐧Equip a buddy to watch your back
🌳Hang out and chill in the Tree House
🐟Go fishing for sweet, sweet rewards

UPDATES:
New adventures incoming!
Fresh content drops every week, so the fun never stops and the weird only gets weirder.
Algebraic adventure awaits - let’s go!
